layout.body:
Come join us at the
Summer Book Festival!
Date: July 18
Time: 10:00 A.M. – 4:00 P.M.
Location: Town Square
Enjoy author signings, book readings, and literary workshops. This event is perfect for book lovers of all ages, with a special area dedicated to young readers.
Admission is free.
A variety of food and beverages will be available for purchase from local food trucks and vendors.
Free parking is available at the Town Square parking lot and nearby streets.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the notice?

options.A: To advertise a used-book sales event
options.B: To announce an event for people who like reading
options.C: To promote an event celebrating the publication of a new book
options.D: To advertise prices for a series of writing workshops

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the notice? 原文依据：Come join us at the Summer Book Festival! This event is perfect for book lovers of all ages. 来参加夏季图书节吧！这个活动适合所有年龄段的读书爱好者。 (A) 为旧书销售活动做广告 → 错误 (B) 为喜欢阅读的人宣布一项活动 → 正确 (C) 宣传庆祝一本新书出版的活动 → 错误 (D) 为一系列写作工坊宣传价格 → 错误

questions.stem: Where will the event take place?
questions.analysis: Where will the event take place? 原文依据：Location: Town Square 地点：市政广场 (A) 在当地一家书店 → 错误 (B) 在图书馆 → 错误 (C) 在市政广场 → 正确 (D) 在社区中心 → 错误

questions.stem: What can be concluded about the Summer Book Festival?
questions.analysis: What can be concluded about the Summer Book Festival? 原文依据：This event is perfect for book lovers of all ages, with a special area dedicated to young readers. 该活动适合所有年龄段的读书爱好者，并有专为小读者设立的区域。 (A) 它适合儿童 → 正确 (B) 它有注册费 → 错误 (C) 它将持续一整天 → 错误 (D) 它需要门票 → 错误
